name: Parity
positioning: Remote HVAC optimization for multifamily and hotels, with utility savings guaranteed or refunded.
description: Parity remotely monitors and adjusts HVAC systems in multifamily buildings and hotels, using machine learning to reset setpoints and equipment behavior in real time without on-site staff intervention. It sells the outcome as a guaranteed savings service rather than a self-serve dashboard: it commits to a percentage reduction in utility costs and refunds the difference if it misses.
real_estate_use: A multifamily owner with an aging HVAC fleet across several buildings does not have the engineering staff to retune each system building by building; Parity ingests operational data from the equipment, streams optimized control adjustments back to it continuously, and reports the realized savings against its guarantee — turning an energy-efficiency retrofit that would otherwise require capital and a contractor into a subscription with the risk on Parity's side.
features: Remote real-time HVAC control and optimization
Guaranteed utility cost savings with refund if missed

use_cases.job: Cut HVAC utility costs across a multifamily portfolio without an in-house retuning project
Add a guaranteed-savings energy program to an asset without capital spend
